messages:
fernanda: Hey team — stayed in a shared hotel room with my partner while on a week-long client trip. The hotel charged minibar and valet to the room and accidentally posted the minibar to the company card. How should I handle separating personal charges vs company charges? cc @manager-kevin :grimacing:

alex: Two quick paths: 1) ask hotel to produce an itemized folio and shift incidental charges to a personal folio or reverse them; or 2) if hotel can't split post-checkout, pay the incidental amount personally and get a signed adjustment or receipt from the hotel showing they reversed the charge to your personal card.

fernanda: Hotel says they can issue a folio adjustment but it might take 2-3 business days. I need to close my expense now. Can I submit and note the pending adjustment?

manager-kevin: Yes — submit the expense with the corporate-eligible lines only (room rate, taxes, business meals if applicable) and add a note: "pending folio adjustment for personal incidental(s)." Attach the original folio and the card statement. Finance will put a hold and clear after adjustment receipt. :white_check_mark:

people-ops: Policy recap: personal incidental charges (minibar, personal meals, valet for non-business vehicles, spa for partner) are not reimbursable. If accidentally charged to the company card, traveler must get hotel to reverse those charges or pay them personally and submit proof.

people-ops: Required docs when hotel posts spouse/personal incidentals to company card:
```
- Full hotel folio showing line-items (room rate, taxes, incidentals)
- Card statement showing the charge on company card
- Either (A) hotel folio adjustment or refund proof OR (B) personal card receipt showing reimbursement to hotel + signed hotel acknowledgment
- Expense note explaining shared-room situation and partner name
- Manager approval if expense contains borderline items
```

alex: If the hotel refuses to issue an adjustment, finance will usually require you to pay the incidental charge personally and upload a personal-card receipt or a signed hotel letter saying which lines are personal. We cannot absorb personal charges.

fernanda: What about group bookings where one person pays for multiple rooms and we split later? The travel vendor billed all rooms to one card. How to claim my portion?

manager-kevin: For multi-room bookings, best practice: ask vendor for separate folios per room at checkout. If one folio exists, attach the master invoice and provide a manager-signed note listing room assignments and amounts. Finance prefers separate folios; without them, reimbursement may need manager and Travel Admin sign-off.

people-ops: Quick note on cancellation/penalty fees: if you incur change or cancellation fees because of a business-mandated itinerary change, these are reimbursable with manager approval. If you cancel for personal reasons, fees are personal. Attach vendor emails showing the reason for the change.

fernanda: Also: I bought travel insurance when booking because the travel agent recommended it. Can I claim the insurance premium?

people-ops: We do not routinely reimburse travel insurance premiums for personal add-ons. If the insurance was required by the company for a specific high-risk trip and pre-approved, it can be reimbursed. Otherwise insurance premiums are personal. Travel Admin can advise on company-covered insurance cases.

finance-bot: Reminder: any expense where the company card shows mixed personal and business items must include documentation showing how personal lines will be removed. Missing docs = audit flag and potential hold.

alex: Edge case: hotel posts incidental then issues a refund to the company card but you've already been reimbursed. Finance will reconcile by deducting the refunded amount from future reimbursements or asking you to refund the company. Keep screenshots of the refund transaction.

fernanda: Thanks everyone 94 I'll attach the folio + card stmt and a note saying I'm waiting on the hotel's adjustment. I've also asked them to email a reversal and will upload it when it arrives.

manager-kevin: Sounds good 94 approve pending adjustment. Finance, please keep an eye for the follow-up doc.

people-ops: Policy snippet to include in the expense note if needed: "Shared room with partner; incidental charges posted to company card. Hotel folio attached. Pending folio adjustment requested; will upload reversal once received."
